scopes.label: Account state
scopes.description: Status, restriction timestamps, and lifecycle state without credentials.

scopes.label: Authentication events
scopes.description: Bounded security-event type, outcome metadata, and time without tokens or credential material.

scopes.label: Chronicle history metadata
scopes.description: History record identifiers, lifecycle state, edition checksum, and dates without prose, reflections, Memories, or media.

scopes.label: Community activity
scopes.description: Profile moderation state and aggregate listing, report, and Voyage Log counts without private content.

scopes.label: Session diagnostics
scopes.description: Session type and bounded timing/state diagnostics without cookies, CSRF values, or token hashes.

scopes.label: Profile diagnostics
scopes.description: Profile state and non-content completeness signals without private biography or private media.
